balloons.css: .cb-demo-promotion{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;width:300px;height:250px;overflow:hidden;padding:23px;border-radius:18px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#5b5ce2,#3637a9);color:#fff;font:15px/1.35 system-ui,sans-serif}.cb-demo-promotion__orb{position:absolute;width:150px;height:150px;right:-46px;top:-54px;border-radius:50%;background:#95d8c7;box-shadow:-56px 116px 0 4px #ff7d69;opacity:.92}.cb-demo-promotion p,.cb-demo-promotion h3,.cb-demo-promotion>span:not(.cb-demo-promotion__orb),.cb-demo-promotion a{position:relative}.cb-demo-promotion p{margin:0 0 17px;font-size:10px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase}.cb-demo-promotion h3{max-width:210px;margin:0 0 8px;font-size:30px;line-height:.98;letter-spacing:-.04em}.cb-demo-promotion>span:not(.cb-demo-promotion__orb){color:#e7e8ff;font-size:12px}.cb-demo-promotion a{align-self:flex-start;margin-top:auto;color:#fff;font-weight:800;text-underline-offset:4px}.cb-demo-promotion a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #fff;outline-offset:3px}
